That sentence isn't stupid. It's just the first honest version — and it's a lot more true than "busy, good busy." That answer kept Sunday easy; this one actually lets her in.

And she asked how you were. That's her leaving the door open a crack. You don't have to swing it wide — you could text something like: "Can I call you sometime? Rent went up and I'm trying to figure out what to do. Not an emergency, I just don't want to sit with it alone."

What feels harder — typing the sentence to her, or imagining what she says back?
